name: I2-SDF
aliases: Intrinsic Indoor Scene Reconstruction and Editing via Raytracing in Neural SDFs
definition: A holistic neural SDF-based framework for complex indoor scenes that jointly recovers the underlying shape, radiance, and material fields from multi-view images.
summary: I2-SDF is a neural implicit framework that reconstructs indoor scenes using Signed Distance Fields and decomposes radiance via surface-based raytracing to enable physically based relighting and editing.
